photos.name: dough-in-bowl-during-bulk
photos.summary: Sourdough dough in glass mixing bowl on silicone pastry mat during bulk fermentation. Dough surface is smooth with light flour dusting. Bowl is on a wooden counter with red-ringed measurement guides visible on the mat.

photos.name: focaccia-crumb-shot
photos.summary: Hand holding a cross-section slice of the focaccia showing dense, tight crumb with small uniform holes — white-bread texture throughout. Golden-brown crust visible around the edges. Hardwood floor in background.

photos.name: focaccia-finished-on-rack
photos.summary: Finished focaccia loaf cooling on copper wire rack. Golden-brown top crust with visible flaky salt and Italian seasoning. Loaf pan shape, good rise. Living room visible in background with silicone pastry mat on counter.
